runner: run_molmoact_libero.py: the loop of molmoact experiments/libero/run_libero_eval.py (Hugging Face inference; its step() and gripper functions imported)
env_seed: env.seed(0) in get_libero_env; seed 7 at the start of every task
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: Official MolmoAct LIBERO settings of the Hugging Face script: per-suite checkpoint, bfloat16, agentview + wrist images with 90 percent center crop, depth + trace + action generation (max 512 new tokens), unnorm_key libero_<suite>_no_noops_modified, whole action matrix executed per query, an unparsable output executes one zero action, 10 no-op steps, max steps 220/280/300/520, seed 7. The README replicates its numbers with vLLM 0.8.5, which has no RTX 5090 kernels. Checkpoints stored as bf16 (loaded as bf16 anyway). Env envs/molmoact (venv on roboelo-libero, transformers 4.52.1, torch 2.7.1+cu128, MuJoCo 3.3.2); Qwen/Qwen2-7B tokenizer (used by parse_action) cached for offline use.
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
